text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Man, how pathetic...! I lost big time...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"To think I didn't even make the board... 
I just wanna crawl into a hole and die..."
choice_data_list: No time to be standing around!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...! Those words right there really hit me 
right in the heart...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I definitely gave it everything I had. 
Losing despite that just means I wasn't 
strong enough. Plain and simple. I can't 
turn a blind eye to that.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You kept your eyes on a good-for-nothin' 
like me the whole time, Boss...!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Big Sis has been watching over a 
good-for-nothing like me this whole 
time...!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Retrain me so I can come back in 
first place next time! I'm counting on 
you!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, you're right on the money, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, you're right on the money, Sis.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Tucking your tail and running away after a 
loss ain't how a true Edokko rolls!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely gonna win next time! So 
hurry up and tell me what I need to do for 
that!
